caveats.timeoutControl: Profiling overhead advances the production wall clock; timeout control is descriptive and not logical-parity evidence.
caveats.shadowDuplicates: Exact only within deterministic sampled expanded states; not a random estimator and not production work.
caveats.rankingDedup: Production ranks before key construction; uniqueness of later ranking pre-rejects remains unavailable after the beam-pruned latch.
caveats.targetRelevance: Color/layer mismatch is a descriptive proxy, not a sound pruning proof.
